summary: Ryanair Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K solely to announce its Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 10, 2026, along with the posting of the notice, proxy form, and annual report. This is a routine corporate governance notification with no special-situation elements such as mergers, tender offers, or strategic actions. The filing contains no financial terms, advisor appointments, or board recommendations beyond standard meeting procedures. As a routine AGM notice, it does not qualify as a special situation under the defined categories, and no deal terms apply.
